change.title: Type runtime mutation leases and close the local Skill host race
change.summary: Adds the bounded S3 RuntimeMutationLease contract. Existing process-local lifecycle serialization is projected through intent, destructive, host-bridge, and terminal domains. The local Skill picker remains outside the lease; after selection, one short host-bridge lease binds the final matching healthy Science host receipt through package commit and OPERON attach/readback. Existing DTO/text, attachment partial-commit behavior, and non-durable operation semantics remain unchanged.

basis: the typed lease unit regression proves all four runtime mutation domains share the existing exclusive process-local serializer
the local Skill regression proves a destructive mutation blocks package commit until the short host-bridge lease can claim the final matching host context
the source boundary requires production runtime-context mutations to declare a typed domain and binds local package commit plus attach/readback to one host receipt and lease
cargo check and focused Rust/Python source tests pass
the picker and any future download remain outside the lease, attachment failure still retains committed files, and no global durable journal is introduced
